svg.title: Zero Trust control overlay
svg.desc: Nine numbered stages with separate host, internal service, and cluster pivots. Green badges identify proposed gates. Blue, amber, and purple labeled badges map gates to Verify explicitly, Use least privilege access, and Assume breach. These are proposed defenses, not historical controls.
svg.text: Same progression. Independent checks where authority changes.

g.text: G4 | Limit and verify upload grants
G5 | Limit reads to assigned input
G9 | Revoke and verify the stop

svg.text: not one mandatory sequence or one agent's full run.
Green gates are proposed defenses. Red arrows preserve the incident path for comparison.
Razi Rais | Zero Trust for AI Systems
